rationale.automation-bias: Experienced developers report proficiency erosion; juniors show greater confidence and weaker caution.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Faster generation coincides with additional security-review and documentation effort.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Developers report and recommend scanners and testing for generated-code vulnerabilities.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers recommend thorough human review before integration or production deployment.
